title: Notes must agree at the joins.
body: Compare notes where they overlap. Keep the warnings.

title: Give each note its own card.
body: Let notes differ. Compare them where they meet.

title: Keep the red join red.
body: Report the real colour. Name who fixes it.

title: Map the joins, then merge.
body: Map the links first. Then decide to merge.

title: Show both sides of the edge.
body: When sources disagree, show both. Then check.

title: One owner for every join.
body: Give each shared piece one owner. Check copies.

title: Seven opinions, one line.
body: Let neighbours agree. Then check the answer.

title: Keep both. Mark the join.
body: Never let memory write over. Show the clash.

title: Test the gate by breaking it.
body: Trust a check only after it fails once.

title: Trust the parts that agree.
body: Trust what fits its neighbours. Check the rest.

title: Fold only the joins that agree.
body: Check every join. Keep disagreements in sight.

title: Odd joins wait for a person.
body: Let odd results wait for a person.

title: Every push meets the gate.
body: Put a shape check on every push.

title: Let every join pull back.
body: Know which parts touch. Let them pull.

title: Floppy parts have fewer joins.
body: Check what holds a part before trusting it.

title: See every link below the top.
body: Look two rows down before you fund.

title: Credit should flow down the links.
body: When you thank a project, thank its links.

title: Draw only links you can show.
body: Every link on your map needs a source.

title: Let the unfinished joins glow.
body: Show the gaps you know about. Name them.

title: Rules on top, parts below.
body: Sort your map into rows before sharing.

title: A wiki with pins.
body: Pick three things your wiki must keep.

title: Merge, and keep the seams.
body: When you merge, keep conflicts visible.

title: The same mistake, pinned.
body: Found a mistake twice? Make it a check.

title: Don't touch the gate.
body: Agents fix the work. Never the checks.

title: We choose the pins.
body: Borrow the idea. Never borrow the proof.

title: Try first. Then the gate opens.
body: Try before you look. Every time.

title: Find the pin first.
body: Stuck? Ask what stays the same.

title: Small changes, one counter.
body: Track the total, not just each change.

title: AI writes. The gate checks.
body: Let AI write. Let machines check. You decide.

title: Two copies, one seam.
body: Two copies? Check them where they meet.

title: Give every note a label.
body: Say what each piece is before you send.

title: Hand over only the right cards.
body: Give each helper only what its job needs.

title: One fact at every joint.
body: Write each fact once. Check every copy.

title: Private cards stay home.
body: Mark what is private before you reuse it.

title: Send the wiring, not the pile.
body: Send the shape. Add files when asked.

title: Draw the sockets first.
body: Save each step's inputs. Rerun only what changed.

title: See every joint first.
body: Check what leans on it before changing.

title: Add the missing piece.
body: When parts don't fit, name the converter.

title: Each helper gets its own part.
body: Split work so no helpers share a spot.

title: Find the joint that slipped.
body: Build it two ways. Look where they differ.

title: Build it once, with slots.
body: Write the steps once. Fill them each time.

title: Stop when the counter hits zero.
body: Repeat until fresh eyes find nothing. Then stop.

title: Send only what clears the gate.
body: Set a bar. Score it. Then send.

title: One line for every puzzle.
body: Checkable task? Ask for the method, not answers.

title: Every try gets a tick.
body: Keep every try. Then you can go back.

title: A small gate picks the road.
body: Ask how hard it is before you start.

title: Check every join in the chain.
body: Check between steps, not just at the end.

title: Keep the judge pinned.
body: Let the work change. Never the judge.

title: One change, then measure.
body: Change one thing. Measure it. Keep what wins.

title: Let it draft the cards first.
body: Ask for the prompt first. Then add facts.

title: Hunches don't fit the slot.
body: Let only evidence pull the ship lever.

title: When unsure, the gate stays shut.
body: Make unsure mean stop, not go.

title: Every step gets a tick.
body: Write down each step. Act once, last.

title: Doing waits behind the gate.
body: Keep sending off until you choose it.

title: Five small gates, not one.
body: Split the question until each answer is checkable.

title: First, check the ruler.
body: Test the test first. Then trust the score.

title: Coin flips go to a person.
body: Coin toss? Hand it to a person.

title: Leave the flag where it is.
body: Keep the mismatch visible until it is fixed.

title: Every claim faces the same gates.
body: Judge claims by tests, including your own.

title: Readers pass a one-way gate.
body: Let people read without the keys.

title: Every miss gets a new gate.
body: Machines check every run. Misses become new checks.

title: Add a different gate.
body: Don't add copies. Add a new kind.

title: Turn every miss into a gate.
body: Every miss is the start of a check.

title: The old bug hits a gate.
body: Every fix ships with its failing check.

title: Fresh eyes try to break it.
body: Never let the builder be the judge.

title: Check the pin before the work.
body: Check your rules as hard as your work.

title: Find the first broken joint.
body: Check where steps meet. Find breaks fast.

title: Show one real example.
body: When it says it exists, ask for one.

title: Seven gates watch every frame.
body: Let machines count. You judge what matters.

title: Check the work, not its label.
body: Trust what came out, not what it says.

title: Every answer keeps its receipt.
body: Ask every answer where it came from.

title: Give every note a label.
body: Label how sure. Raise it only by checking.

title: Every step leaves a mark.
body: Keep the record. Move on only on green.

title: Draw only the joins you see.
body: Show the gaps. Never draw hopeful lines.

title: Test where the parts join.
body: Test where your parts meet, not alone.

title: A gate after every step.
body: Put a check after every step.

title: Let the check only look.
body: A checker should never change what it checks.

title: Some numbers get a pin.
body: Name the numbers no redesign may move.

title: Start with the small card.
body: Give the short version first. Then go deeper.

title: Three runs, one gate.
body: Check it more than one way.

title: Let the colours ring.
body: Before you ship colours, listen to them.

title: Keep the reading pair pinned.
body: Pick any colours. Pin the reading pair.

title: Three parts, many songs.
body: Make new work from parts you can check.

title: Finished is when every gate opens.
body: Don't trust the glance. Run the checks.

title: Shrink it through the gates.
body: Shrink on purpose, one step at a time.

title: Draw the order as one line.
body: Write the order down. Let it check itself.

title: Pull every thread into view.
body: Look at the links between your notes.

title: Every shape gets one pin.
body: Give each shape one job. Reuse it.

title: Taste, one tick at a time.
body: Show your taste with choices, not prompts.

title: Every sound on the tick.
body: Tie each sound to the moment it marks.

title: Every frame lives on the line.
body: Build films you can pause anywhere.

title: Every join must hold.
body: Ship the shorter cut that holds together.

title: Two copies, one card.
body: One owner per fact. Copy from it.

title: Run the ring end to end.
body: Check the whole thing, every time.

title: Nothing fake gets past the door.
body: Check the name exists before you install.

title: Turn each rule into a door.
body: If it matters, make it a check.

title: The old bug meets a door.
body: Every fix leaves a check behind.

title: Lay the cards side by side.
body: Test your score on two different cases.

title: Every version gets a tick.
body: Never edit in place. Make a version.

title: Put a ring on every turn.
body: Let a machine measure what eyes miss.
